SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3073.
Date 8. 4. 32.

Extract from Intelligence Report 11.1.32.
--------

Meeting of White Russians in Shanghai in connection
with the Harbin Incident

Some thirty White Russians representing various
local Russians organizations held a meeting on the premises
of the Cossacks Union, No.311 Route Vallon, between 9 p.m.
and 10.30 p.m. January 8, to discuss the attitude to
be adopted by the local Russian community towards the
recent events in Harbin when, it is reported, a number
of Russians were killed by the Chinese Police.. After
some discussion, it was decided to send a telegram to the
Chairman of the Russian Emigrants Committee in Harbin
asking for a complete report regarding the origin and
the nature of the incident and to request the Russian
community in Shanghai to abstain from participating in
any movement liable to aggravate the situation.

日期 1932年4月8日。

摘自1932年1月11日的情报报告。
--------

在沪白俄就哈尔滨事件举行的会议

约三十名代表各本地俄国组织的白俄于1月8日晚9时至10时30分，在瓦隆路（Route Vallon）311号哥萨克联盟会所举行会议，讨论本地俄国社群针对近期哈尔滨事件的应对态度；据报，在哈尔滨事件中，多名俄国人被中国警察杀害。经讨论后，决定向哈尔滨俄国侨民委员会主席发送电报，要求提供关于该事件起因及性质的完整报告，并请求上海俄国社群避免参与任何可能加剧局势的行动。

S. B. D. 3013
20. 1. 32.

" S L O V C "
January 14, 1932

К событіямъ въ Хар-
бинѣ.

Предсѣдателемъ Казачьяго Со-
юза въ Шанхаѣ полк. Г. К. Бо-
логовымъ вчера получена телег-
рамма отъ Харбинскаго Бѣжен-
скаго Комитета слѣдующаго со-
держанія: «Китайскомъ магазинѣ
избіеніи заподозрѣннаго воров-
ствѣ европейца. Возмущеніе ис-
пользовали силы, заинтересо-
ванныя уличныхъ безпорядкахъ.
Эмиграція отгородилась безпо-
рядковъ. Комитетъ». Эта телеграм-
ма явилась отвѣтомъ на телеграф-
ный запросъ Харбинскому Бѣжен-
скому Комитету, сдѣланный отъ
лица собранія представителей
русскихъ эмигрантскихъ организа-
цій въ Шанхаѣ, состоявшемся 8-
го января текущаго года, на ко-
торомъ обсуждались харбинскія
событія и отношеніе къ нимъ рус-
ской эмиграціи въ Шанхаѣ.

TRANSLATION

The Harbin Incident. Colonel G.K.Bologoff, President of the Cossacks'
Union in Shanghai received the following telegram from the Russian Refugees' Com-
mittee in Harbin yesterday:-" A foreigner suspected of larceny was
severely beaten in a Chinese shop. Parties interested in the street
disturbances used the incident in their own aims. The Emigration has
declined every responsibility for the disturbances."

This telegram is a reply to a telegram addressed to
the President of the Russian Refugees' Committee in Harbin by repre-
sentatives of certain Russian organizations in Shanghai after a mee-
ting at which the attitude to be adopted towards the Harbin incident
was discussed.

O/K. S.B. Safonovarin.
MBR 19/1

1932年1月20日。

" S L O V C "
1932年1月14日

致哈尔-
滨事件。

上海哥萨克联
盟主席 G.K.博洛戈夫
上校昨日收到来自哈
尔滨难民委员会的电
报，内容如下：“一名
涉嫌盗窃的欧洲人在
一家中国商店内遭到
殴打。对街头骚乱感
兴趣的势力利用了此
事件。侨民界已与此
类骚乱划清界限。委
员会”。此电报是对上
海俄国侨民组织代表
会议于本年1月8日发
出的查询的回复，该会
议讨论了哈尔滨事件
及上海俄国侨民对此
的态度。

译文

哈尔滨事件。上海哥萨克联盟主席 G.K.博洛戈夫（G.K.Bologoff）上校昨日收到来自哈尔滨俄国难民委员会的如下电报：“一名涉嫌盗窃的外国人在一家中国商店内遭到毒打。某些意在制造街头骚乱的势力利用此事件达到其自身目的。侨民界拒绝为骚乱承担任何责任。”

此电报系回复由上海某些俄国组织代表在讨论了对哈尔滨事件应采取的态度之后，向哈尔滨俄国难民委员会主席发出的电报查询。

核准。特别股 萨福诺瓦林（Safonovarin）。
MBR 19/1

Subject (in full) Meeting of representatives of local "White" Russian organi-
zations in connection with Harbin incident.

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by J.Blu. a.i

In continuation of a previous report dated January 8,
on the above subject, a meeting of some thirty persons, represent-
ing various Russian organizations in Shanghai, was held between
9 and 10.30 p.m. on January 8, in the premises of the Cossacks
Union, No 311 Route Vallon to discuss the attitude to be adopted
by the local Russian community towards the recent events in Har-
bin when, it is reported, a number of Russians were killed by the
Chinese police.

After some discussion it was decided to send a tele-
gram to the Chairman of the Russian Emigrants Committee in Har-
bin asking for a complete report regarding the origin and the na-
ture of the incident. In the mean time the Russian community in
Shanghai are requested to abstain from participation in any mo-
vement which certain irresponsible elements are reported to
be planning in connection with this affair.

G. Prokofiev
I. S.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
File No.
C. D. 3073.
SECTION 2 / BRANCH
Date January 8, 1932）

Subject (in full) Meeting of representatives of local "White" Russian organi-
zations in connection with Harbin incident.

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by O.Bdn. o1.

During the evening of January 8 a meeting of represen-
tatives of various local "White" Russian organizations will be
held in the premises of the Cossacks' Union, No 311 Route Vallon,
to discuss the attitude of the local Russian community towards
the recent events which took place in Harbin, when, according to
newspapers reports, a number of Russians were killed by the Chine-
se police.

This meeting has been called on the initiative of the
President of the Cossacks' Union in Shanghai in order to prevent
certain elements among the local Russian community from starting
undesirable activity in connection with this affair, as it is repor-
ted that a number of irresponsible Russian youths, the majority
of whom being recent arrivals from Harbin, who have been aroused
over the happenings referred to above, are planning to launch a
protest movement against the action of Chinese Authorities in
Harbin. In a draft of a leaflet which they had intended to issue
on January 5 they appeal to local Russians to hold a peaceful mass-
demonstration in front of the American Consulate General on Janu-
ry 10 ( time not stated) when a petition was to be presented to
the Senior Consul describing the unfortunate conditions under
which white Russians are living in Harbin, and to ask him to bring
the matter to the attention of the various foreign powers for any
action deemed necessary.

The meeting will be attended by the undersigned and
matters of interest will be immediately reported.

（批：Rush
9 JAN 400）

G. Prokofiev
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Commissioner of Police,
Sir, (Information). J. Swaine
O. i/c Sp. Br.

第二分区 / 股
日期 1932年1月8日）

主题（全称） 本地“白”俄组织代表就哈尔滨事件举行的会议。

撰写人 D.S.普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.Prokofiev） 转呈人 O.Bdn. o1.

1月8日晚间，各本地“白”俄组织代表将在瓦隆路（Route Vallon）311号哥萨克联盟会所举行会议，讨论本地俄国社群针对近期在哈尔滨发生的事件的态度；据报纸报道，在该事件中，多名俄国人被中国警察杀害。

此次会议由上海哥萨克联盟主席发起，旨在防止本地俄国社群中的某些分子就此事宜开展不良活动；据报，许多不负责任的俄国青年（其中多数为近期从哈尔滨抵达者）因上述事件而激愤，正策划发起一场抗议运动，以反对中国当局在哈尔滨的行动。在他们拟于1月5日发布的一份传单草稿中，他们呼吁本地俄国人于1月10日（时间未注明）在美国总领事馆前举行和平大规模示威，届时将向首席领事递交请愿书，陈述白俄在哈尔滨生活的悲惨状况，并请其将此事项提请各外国列强注意，以便采取其认为必要的行动。

签署人将出席此次会议，并立即报告相关重要事项。

（批注：急件
1月9日 400）

G. 普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）
D. S.

特别股主管警官。

警务处处长，
先生，（供参考）。 J. Swaine
